name: Kameraya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood camera shop: a camera repair service announcement, a first day learning how to use a camera, a camera price and point-card guide, a large-photo print service announcement, a lens-cleaning course comparison, a column on learning to ask customers about their preferences, a part-timer lesson on basic camera operation, an explainer on why a photo-class corner started, a graduation-photo booking guide, a column on how online booking changed the shop's day, a busy-season booking rule, a column on the meaning of a camera shop's craft, and a one-year cooperation report with a nearby lens maker.
